title: SCHEDULED POWER INTERRUPTION: JULY 26, 2026
post_text:
SCHEDULED POWER INTERRUPTION: JULY 26, 2026
Ginapahibalo sang Negros Power ang mga konsumidores nga may ara sang natalana nga power interruption sa July 26, 2026 (Sunday).
Ini kabahin sang 5-year rehabilitation kag modernization plan sang Negros Power agud malikawan ang mga wala ginalauman kag mas lapnagon nga power interruptions kag mangin reliable ang distribution system sang aton elektrisidad.
Yari ang mga detalye sang scheduled power interruption:
Date: July 26, 2026 (Sunday)
Reason: Massive Installation of rubber inserts, insulator replacement Distribution Transformer & Fuse Cut Out covers, and fuse coordination along Negros South Rd. Bago.
Time & Affected Areas:
6:00AM to 3:00PM
Whole of HF1 - Whole of HF1 - From Lag-asan or Hilangban Substation, Brgy. Lag-asan, Bago City College, Prk. Kapahuan 1 & 2, Bago City Hospital, Prk. Santan, San Esteban Phase 2, Sta. Catalina Subdivision, Brgy. Sampinit, San Sebastian Village, Brgy. Balingasag (Prk. Potat, Prk. Rosal, Prk. Violetas), San Gabriel Subd., Brgy. Sampinit, Villa Cristeta Ph 3, Southbay Subdivision, South Valley, HDA. Yusay, portion of Brgy. Calumangan until Bangga Ma. Morena, Brgy. Calumanggan, Purok Batad, Bago City Hospital.
Note: We may energize earlier than the scheduled time once the rehabilitation activity is completed.
Madamo gid nga salamat sa inyo nga pag hangop.
